svg.text: ScanLab / parallelizable algebra is not a speed benchmark
Exact rational recurrence + work-efficient prefix DAG. A separate float model has explicit reverse gradients.
1 Same exact states, shorter dependency span, more scalar work
Apply left then right: (a1,b1) composed with (a2,b2) = (a2*a1, a2*b1+b2).
Serial Python executes both paths. Span treats a whole vector composition/apply as one unit.
2 Fixed LTI recurrence equals causal convolution, including initial state
Direct quadratic finite convolution, no FFT, HiPPO, S4 kernel or continuous-time discretization.
decay=1; writes=[1e16,1,-1e16,1]; initial=0. Exact rational final state is 2.
4 Input-dependent gates: differentiated, streaming, not a fixed convolution
h_t = sigmoid(theta + u*x_t) * h_(t-1) + B*x_t; y_t = C dot h_t + D*x_t
Streaming chunks preserve causal outputs. Gates are functions of the current input, not prior state.
No trained-model quality, GPU throughput, Mamba implementation, exact sigmoid or bitwise equivalence claim.
